messages.subject: Version 0.9.14 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Version 0.9.14 of Nvim-R was released. The github repository <https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R> now includes a stable branch <https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/tree/stable> that will receive bug fixes. I still added the Vimball to vim.org <http://vim.org>, but the best way of using a stable release now is installing vim-plug <https://github.com/junegunn/vim-plug> (or another package manager that can select specific branches from github) and choosing the stable branch, as explained in the README <https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/blob/master/README.md>. Please, report any bugs on github repository <https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R>. You may also want to subscribe to the notification of new releases by clicking on the Watch button.

The changes in this new version are:
New command \su (send all lines above the current one).
New command \m (send lines from motion command).
New option: R_disable_cmds.
New option: R_after_ob_open.
R_after_start is a list now.
Recommend Visidata and delete option R_csv_warn.
Delete command triggered by <LocalLeader>tp.
Delete options R_args_in_stline, R_sttline_fmt, R_show_args, R_complete and Rtools_path.
Limited support for debugging R functions.
Best regards,

Jakson Aquino
